```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# ==============================================================================
# 1. Global Configuration & Environment
# ==============================================================================
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
options(scipen = 999, digits = 4)

# [CRITICAL] Sum-to-zero contrasts for valid Type III ANOVA results
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))

if(!require("pacman")) install.packages("pacman")
pacman::p_load(
  here, readr, readxl, dplyr, tidyr, stringr,  # Data Wrangling
  lme4, lmerTest,                              # Modeling (lmerTest is key for F-tests)
  car, performance,                            # Diagnostics
  buildmer,                                    # Random Structure Optimization
  emmeans, effectsize,                         # Statistical Inference
  sjPlot, sjmisc,                              # Quick Visualization
  ggplot2, ggpubr, gridExtra,                  # Publication Visualization
  openxlsx                                     # Excel Reporting
)


# [CONFIG] Force calculation of Denominator DF (Avoids 'Inf' df in post-hoc)
emmeans::emm_options(lmerTest.limit = 50000, pbkrtest.limit = 50000)

# [PATH] Output Directory: Separated for E1
# Structure: results/EEG/E1_Stats_Regression_Method/[Component]/
out_root <- here("results", "EEG", "E1_Stats_Regression_Method")
if(!dir.exists(out_root)) dir.create(out_root, recursive = TRUE)

# Visual Theme
theme_set(theme_bw(base_size = 14) + 
          theme(panel.grid.minor = element_blank(), legend.position = "top"))

# Palettes
colors_emo <- c('neu'="#8491B4",'aff'="#91D1C2",'dis'="#E64B35",'dom'="#F39B7F",'enj'="#3C5488")
labels_emo <- c('neu'='Neutral','aff'='Affiliative','dis'='Disgust','dom'='Dominance','enj'='Reward')
colors_off <- c('fair'="#2E86AB",'unfair'="#A23B72")
labels_off <- c('fair'='Fair', 'unfair'='Unfair')

# [OPTIMIZATION] Define Robust Control Settings
# bobyqa is more robust for complex LMMs; calc.derivs=FALSE speeds up computation
custom_control <- lmerControl(optimizer = "bobyqa", 
                              optCtrl = list(maxfun = 200000), 
                              calc.derivs = FALSE)

```

```{r apa-module}
# ==============================================================================
# Helper: Format ANOVA F-Table to APA String (Robust Implementation)
# ==============================================================================
format_anova_apa <- function(anova_obj) {
  df_res <- as.data.frame(anova_obj) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("Effect")
  
  # Calculate Partial Eta Squared based on F-values
  es_df <- data.frame(Parameter = character(), Eta2_partial = numeric())
  tryCatch({
    es <- effectsize::eta_squared(anova_obj, partial = TRUE, ci = 0.95, verbose = FALSE)
    es_df <- as.data.frame(es) %>% select(Parameter, Eta2_partial)
  }, error = function(e) NULL)
  
  # Merge Effect Size back safely
  if(nrow(es_df) > 0) {
    df_res <- left_join(df_res, es_df, by = c("Effect" = "Parameter"))
  } else {
    df_res$Eta2_partial <- NA
  }
  
  # Safe column extractors to prevent 'object not found'
  get_col <- function(col_name) if(col_name %in% names(df_res)) df_res[[col_name]] else NA
  
  df_res <- df_res %>%
    mutate(
      F_val  = get_col("F value"),
      NumDF  = get_col("NumDF"),
      DenDF  = get_col("DenDF"),
      p_val  = get_col("Pr(>F)"),
      
      # P-value Formatting (Ensure '=' is present for exact values)
      p_str = case_when(
        is.na(p_val) ~ "-",
        p_val < .001 ~ "< .001",
        TRUE ~ paste0("= ", sprintf("%.3f", p_val))
      ),
      Eta_str = ifelse(is.na(Eta2_partial), "-", sprintf("%.2f", Eta2_partial)),
      
      # APA String Construction
      APA_Report = case_when(
        !is.na(F_val) & !is.na(NumDF) & !is.na(DenDF) ~ 
          sprintf("F(%s, %.2f) = %.2f, p %s, np2 = %s", NumDF, DenDF, F_val, p_str, Eta_str),
        TRUE ~ "Format not supported"
      )
    ) %>%
    # Select final relevant columns for clarity in reporting
    select(Effect, APA_Report, F_value = F_val, NumDF, DenDF, p_value = p_val, Eta2_partial)
  
  return(df_res)
}

# ==============================================================================
# Helper: Format Post-hoc t-tests (with CI)
# ==============================================================================
format_posthoc_apa <- function(emm_df) {
  df_clean <- as.data.frame(emm_df)
  
  if("t.ratio" %in% names(df_clean)) {
    df_clean <- df_clean %>%
      mutate(
        # Standardized p-value reporting
        p_str = case_when(
          p.value < .001 ~ "< .001", 
          TRUE ~ paste0("= ", sprintf("%.3f", p.value))
        ),
        t_str = sprintf("%.2f", t.ratio),
        df_str = sprintf("%.2f", df), 
        
        # Safely extract estimate depending on emmeans output format
        estimate_col = if("estimate" %in% names(.)) estimate else if("response" %in% names(.)) response else NA,
        estimate_str = sprintf("%.2f", estimate_col),
        se_str = sprintf("%.2f", SE),
        
        # Report String Construction
        Stats_String = sprintf("b = %s (SE=%s), t(%s) = %s, p %s", 
                               estimate_str, se_str, df_str, t_str, p_str)
      )
  }
  return(df_clean)
}

# ==============================================================================
# Helper: Format Raw Coefficients (For Directionality Checks)
# ==============================================================================
format_coefs <- function(model) {
  coefs <- summary(model)$coefficients %>% as.data.frame() %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("Predictor")
  
  # Ensure column names map correctly depending on lmer vs glmer structures
  get_col <- function(col_name) if(col_name %in% names(coefs)) coefs[[col_name]] else NA
  
  coefs %>% mutate(
    p_val = get_col("Pr(>|t|)"),
    p_str = case_when(
      is.na(p_val) ~ "-",
      p_val < .001 ~ "< .001", 
      TRUE ~ paste0("= ", sprintf("%.3f", p_val))
    ),
    Estimate_str = sprintf("%.2f", Estimate),
    SE_str = sprintf("%.2f", `Std. Error`),
    t_str = sprintf("%.2f", `t value`),
    
    Report = sprintf("b = %s, SE = %s, t = %s, p %s", Estimate_str, SE_str, t_str, p_str)
  )
}
```

```{r prep-functions}
# ==============================================================================
# Data Loading & Cleaning
# ==============================================================================
standardize_id <- function(ids) {
  nums <- as.numeric(str_extract(ids, "\\d+"))
  sprintf("Vp%04d", nums)
}

load_covariates <- function(path_cov) {
  if(!file.exists(path_cov)) { warning("Covariate file missing"); return(NULL) }
  cat(sprintf("   [Covariates] Loading: %s\n", basename(path_cov)))
  
  if(grepl("\\.csv$", path_cov)) df_cov <- read_csv(path_cov, show_col_types=FALSE) else df_cov <- read_excel(path_cov)
  
  names(df_cov)[1] <- "raw_id"
  df_cov$participant_id <- standardize_id(df_cov$raw_id)
  
  # Standardize column names based on user input
  if("Rating_1" %in% names(df_cov)) df_cov <- rename(df_cov, Reaction_Score = Rating_1)
  
  # Select and standardize
  df_cov %>% 
    select(participant_id, SVO_angle, SVO_type, Reaction_Score, any_of(c("Antagonism","Detachment","Disinhibition"))) %>%
    mutate(SVO_Z = if("SVO_angle" %in% names(.)) as.numeric(scale(SVO_angle)) else NA_real_)
}

load_and_prep <- function(path_erp, df_covariates, erp_name, baseline_col) {
  if(!file.exists(path_erp)) stop("ERP file missing")
  df <- read_csv(path_erp, show_col_types=FALSE)
  df$participant_id <- standardize_id(df$participant_id)
  
  # 1. Filter Offer Types (Fair vs Unfair, exclude 7:3)
  df <- df %>%
    filter(Offers_Other %in% c(5, 6, 8, 9)) %>%
    mutate(
      offer_type = case_when(Offers_Other %in% c(5,6)~"fair", Offers_Other %in% c(8,9)~"unfair"),
      emotion = factor(emotion, levels = c("neu", "aff", "dis", "dom", "enj")),
      offer_type = factor(offer_type, levels = c("fair", "unfair"))
    )
  
  # 2. Artifact Rejection (200 uV threshold)
  orig_n <- nrow(df)
  df <- df %>% filter(abs(!!sym(erp_name)) < 200)
  if(orig_n > nrow(df)) cat(sprintf("   [QC] %s: Dropped %d trials > 200µV\n", erp_name, orig_n-nrow(df)))
  
  # 3. Baseline Centering (Grand Mean)
  if(!is.null(baseline_col) && baseline_col %in% names(df)) {
    df$Baseline_Raw <- df[[baseline_col]]
    df$Baseline_c <- df$Baseline_Raw - mean(df$Baseline_Raw, na.rm=TRUE)
  } else { df$Baseline_c <- 0 }
  
  # 4. Merge Covariates
  if(!is.null(df_covariates)) df <- left_join(df, df_covariates, by = "participant_id")
  return(df)
}

check_uniqueness <- function(df, context_name) {
  if(nrow(df) != n_distinct(select(df, participant_id, index))) 
    stop(sprintf("CRITICAL ERROR: Duplicate keys (ID+Index) found in %s", context_name))
}
```

```{r stats-engine}
run_regression_analysis <- function(data, erp_name, out_dir, use_svo = FALSE) {
  
  # Sub-directory creation
  sub_dir <- file.path(out_dir, erp_name)
  if(!dir.exists(sub_dir)) dir.create(sub_dir)
  
  cat(sprintf("\n>>> Analyzing Component: %s (Subjects: %d)\n", erp_name, n_distinct(data$participant_id)))
  
  # --- Step 1: Model Specification ---
  fixed_effects <- paste0(erp_name, " ~ emotion * offer_type + emotion * Baseline_c")
  if(use_svo && "SVO_Z" %in% names(data)) {
    cat("   [Config] Including SVO Moderation in initial model...\n")
    fixed_effects <- paste0(erp_name, " ~ emotion * offer_type * SVO_Z + emotion * Baseline_c")
  }

  # --- Step 2: Random Structure Optimization ---
  cat("   [Phase 1] Optimizing Random Structure (bobyqa)...\n")
  
  f_buildmer <- as.formula(paste(fixed_effects, "+ (1 + emotion * offer_type | participant_id)"))
  
  bm_res <- buildmer::buildmer(f_buildmer, data = data,
    buildmerControl = buildmerControl(
        include = as.formula(paste("~", str_split(fixed_effects, "~")[[1]][2])),
        direction = c("order", "backward"), 
        crit = "LRT", quiet = TRUE,
        args = list(control = custom_control)
    ))
  
  # --- Step 3: Final Fit & Inference (F-Tests) ---
  cat("   [Phase 2] Final Fit (REML) & F-Tests...\n")
  
  final_formula <- formula(bm_res@model)
  FINAL_MODEL <- lmer(final_formula, data = data, REML = TRUE, control = custom_control)
  
  formula_str <- paste(deparse(final_formula), collapse = " ")
  cat("\n   [FINAL MODEL FORMULA]:\n   ", formula_str, "\n\n")

  # ANOVA (Type 3, Satterthwaite)
  anova_res <- anova(FINAL_MODEL, type = 3, ddf = "Satterthwaite")
  anova_apa <- format_anova_apa(anova_res)
  print(anova_apa %>% select(Effect, APA_Report))

  # --- Step 4: Robust Post-hoc Strategy ---
  cat("   [Phase 3] Post-hoc Analysis & Logic Branching...\n")
  
  target_term <- "emotion:offer_type"
  svo_survived <- FALSE
  if(use_svo && any(grepl("SVO_Z", row.names(anova_res)))) {
    target_term <- "emotion:offer_type:SVO_Z"
    svo_survived <- TRUE
  } else if (use_svo) {
    cat("   [WARNING] SVO was dropped during optimization. Reverting to standard interaction.\n")
  }
  
  p_int <- anova_res[target_term, "Pr(>F)"]
  if(is.na(p_int)) p_int <- 1.0
  
  at_list <- list(Baseline_c = 0)
  if(svo_survived) at_list$SVO_Z <- c(-1, 1)
  
  rg <- emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, as.formula(paste("~", target_term)), at = at_list)
  
  list_of_tables <- list("ANOVA_Main" = anova_apa)
  list_of_tables[["Model_Formula"]] <- data.frame(Formula = formula_str)
  list_of_tables[["Model_Coefficients"]] <- format_coefs(FINAL_MODEL)
  
  # === Decision Tree ===
  if (p_int < 0.05) {
    cat(sprintf("      -> Interaction SIG (p=%.3f). Breakdown by Emotion.\n", p_int))
    emm_pairs <- contrast(rg, method = "revpairwise", by = "emotion")
    list_of_tables[["Simple_Effects_Interaction"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(test(emm_pairs, adjust="bonferroni"))
    
  } else if (p_int >= 0.05 && p_int < 0.10) {
    cat(sprintf("      -> Interaction MARGINAL (p=%.3f). Main Effects + Exploratory.\n", p_int))
    list_of_tables[["Main_Effect_Offer"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(test(contrast(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~offer_type, at=at_list), "revpairwise"), adjust="bonferroni"))
    list_of_tables[["Main_Effect_Emotion"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(test(contrast(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~emotion, at=at_list), "revpairwise"), adjust="bonferroni"))
    list_of_tables[["Exploratory_Simple_Effects"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(test(contrast(rg, "revpairwise", by="emotion"), adjust="none"))
    
  } else {
    cat(sprintf("      -> Interaction NS (p=%.3f). Main Effects Only.\n", p_int))
    list_of_tables[["Main_Effect_Offer"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(test(contrast(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~offer_type, at=at_list), "revpairwise"), adjust="bonferroni"))
    list_of_tables[["Main_Effect_Emotion"]] <- format_posthoc_apa(test(contrast(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~emotion, at=at_list), "revpairwise"), adjust="bonferroni"))
  }

  list_of_tables[["Descriptive_Means_SE"]] <- as.data.frame(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~ offer_type * emotion, at = list(Baseline_c = 0)))
  
  # --- Step 5: Export to Excel ---
  wb <- createWorkbook()
  for(sheet_name in names(list_of_tables)) {
    safe_sheet_name <- substr(gsub("[^A-Za-z0-9_]", "_", sheet_name), 1, 31)
    addWorksheet(wb, safe_sheet_name)
    writeData(wb, safe_sheet_name, list_of_tables[[sheet_name]])
    addStyle(wb, safe_sheet_name, createStyle(textDecoration="bold", border="Bottom"), rows=1, cols=1:ncol(list_of_tables[[sheet_name]]))
    setColWidths(wb, safe_sheet_name, cols=1:ncol(list_of_tables[[sheet_name]]), widths="auto")
  }
  saveWorkbook(wb, file.path(sub_dir, paste0("STATS_REPORT_", erp_name, ".xlsx")), overwrite = TRUE)

  # --- Step 6: Visualization ---
  cat("   [Phase 4] Visualization...\n")
  
  try({
    p_forest <- sjPlot::plot_model(FINAL_MODEL, type = "est", show.values = TRUE, show.p = TRUE, 
                                   title = paste(erp_name, "Coefficients")) + theme_bw()
    ggsave(file.path(sub_dir, "Diag_Forest_Plot.png"), p_forest, width = 6, height = 8)
  })

  if(svo_survived) {
      pd <- as.data.frame(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~ offer_type * emotion * SVO_Z, at = at_list))
      pd$SVO_Group <- factor(pd$SVO_Z, labels=c("Low SVO", "High SVO"))
      p_final <- ggplot(pd, aes(x = emotion, y = emmean, color = offer_type, group = offer_type)) +
           facet_wrap(~SVO_Group) + 
           geom_line(linewidth=1.2, position=position_dodge(0.2)) + 
           geom_point(size=3, position=position_dodge(0.2)) +
           geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=emmean-SE, ymax=emmean+SE), width=0.2, position=position_dodge(0.2)) +
           scale_color_manual(values = colors_off, labels = labels_off) +
           labs(title = paste(erp_name, "by SVO (Corrected)"), y = "Amplitude (µV)")
  } else {
      pd <- as.data.frame(emmeans(FINAL_MODEL, ~ offer_type * emotion, at = list(Baseline_c = 0)))
      p_final <- ggplot(pd, aes(x = emotion, y = emmean, color = offer_type, group = offer_type)) +
           geom_line(linewidth=1.2, position=position_dodge(0.2)) + 
           geom_point(size=3.5, shape=21, fill="white", stroke=2, position=position_dodge(0.2)) +
           geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=emmean-SE, ymax=emmean+SE), width=0.2, position=position_dodge(0.2)) +
           scale_color_manual(values = colors_off, labels = labels_off) +
           scale_x_discrete(labels = labels_emo) +
           labs(title = paste(erp_name, "Interaction Effect"), 
                subtitle = "Estimated Marginal Means (Baseline Corrected)",
                y = "Amplitude (µV)", x = NULL)
  }
  ggsave(file.path(sub_dir, "Plot_Main_Publication.png"), p_final, width = 8, height = 6)
  
  cat("   >>> Analysis Finished.\n")
}

```

```{r execution}
# ==============================================================================
# Execution Phase
# ==============================================================================
path_pipeline <- here("data", "02_Pipeline_Output")
path_stim <- file.path(path_pipeline, "Method_Regression", "Stimulus_Locked", "trials.csv")
path_resp <- file.path(path_pipeline, "Method_Regression", "Response_Locked", "trials.csv")

path_cov_csv <- file.path(path_pipeline, "Covariates", "SVO_PID5BF_PostRating.csv")
path_cov_xlsx <- file.path(path_pipeline, "Covariates", "SVO_PID5BF_PostRating.xlsx")
path_cov <- if(file.exists(path_cov_csv)) path_cov_csv else path_cov_xlsx

if(!file.exists(path_cov)) warning("Covariates missing.")
if(!file.exists(path_stim)) stop("Stimulus file not found.")

cat("--- Loading Covariates ---\n")
df_covs <- load_covariates(path_cov)

# 1. Stimulus-Locked Analysis
if(file.exists(path_stim)) {
  cat("\n=== Processing Stimulus-Locked Components ===\n")
  
  df_frn <- load_and_prep(path_stim, df_covs, "FRN", "Baseline_FRN") 
  run_regression_analysis(df_frn, "FRN", out_root)
  
  df_n400 <- load_and_prep(path_stim, df_covs, "N400", "Baseline_N400")
  run_regression_analysis(df_n400, "N400", out_root)
  
  df_lpp <- load_and_prep(path_stim, df_covs, "LPP_offer", "Baseline_LPP_offer")
  run_regression_analysis(df_lpp, "LPP_offer", out_root, use_svo = TRUE)
}

# 2. Response-Locked Analysis
if(file.exists(path_resp) && file.exists(path_stim)) {
  cat("\n=== Processing Response-Locked Component (CPP) ===\n")
  
  df_cpp_raw <- load_and_prep(path_resp, df_covs, "CPP", NULL)
  df_stim_base <- read_csv(path_stim, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
      mutate(participant_id = ifelse(grepl("^\\d+$", as.character(participant_id)), 
                                     sprintf("Vp%04d", as.numeric(participant_id)), as.character(participant_id)))
  
  check_uniqueness(df_cpp_raw, "CPP"); check_uniqueness(df_stim_base, "Base")
  
  df_cpp_merged <- left_join(df_cpp_raw, df_stim_base %>% select(participant_id, index, Baseline_LPP_offer), by = c("participant_id", "index"))
  if(sum(is.na(df_cpp_merged$Baseline_LPP_offer)) > 0) warning("CPP: Missing matches.")
  
  df_cpp_merged$Baseline_Raw <- df_cpp_merged$Baseline_LPP_offer
  df_cpp_merged$Baseline_c <- as.numeric(scale(df_cpp_merged$Baseline_Raw, center=TRUE, scale=FALSE))
  
  run_regression_analysis(df_cpp_merged %>% filter(!is.na(Baseline_c)), "CPP", out_root)
}

cat("\n========================================\n")
cat("   Master Analysis Pipeline Completed.\n")
cat("========================================\n")
```
